subject.title: [Feature]: Silent preflight transcription in requireMention channels

question: Should Discord gain a default-off silent audio preflight history mode for `requireMention` channels, and what consent, retention, cost, and visibility limits should it enforce?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the change intentionally processes and retains speech from messages that did not invoke the bot, which is a product/security decision rather than a strict bug fix.

options.title: Approve bounded opt-in mode
options.body: Add a default-off Discord guild/channel option with allowlist-aware transcription, bounded retention, untrusted transcript markings, docs, and focused tests for skipped-history replay.

options.title: Wait for shared media-history policy
options.body: Keep this as product input but avoid a Discord-only knob until maintainers define cross-channel media retention semantics.

options.title: Decline silent transcription
options.body: Keep the current mention-gated behavior if maintainers decide unmentioned speech should not be transcribed or retained without a direct invocation.

recommendation.title: Approve bounded opt-in mode
recommendation.body: Add a default-off Discord guild/channel option with allowlist-aware transcription, bounded retention, untrusted transcript markings, docs, and focused tests for skipped-history replay.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the broadest maintenance of the Discord preflight/history/config-adjacent path that would carry the policy decision.
